verdict.rationale: Several one-command install routes are documented: `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`, `claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official` via Claude Code's official marketplace, and marketplace commands for Codex and Copilot. The docs say you install, then type a slash command. A real runtime probe confirmed the npx path installs skills non-interactively into ./.claude/skills/. missing for 10: hands-on proof that the installed skills are picked up in a fresh agent session (the probe only checked the files on disk); Codex and Copilot each need two commands rather than one.
